title: P-256 sigma rho: metered branchy corrections with a blinded prefix chain, register-resident forward block, 2^20-walk batches, flag-carry product finishes

claims.statement: For uniform full-size P-256 Q=[x]P, the cold classical algorithm in proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.39 under the disclosed H1, M1/L-ori conditional fresh-exposure, H3 pricing and H-trail (average correction count per trail) premises. Total charged work is at most 2^126.879312 units at C=1000 scalar AArch64 instructions/unit. The walk is the predecessor's (A=2^24, K=2^32, theta=2^-60, residual Markov factor 400000) with tau=0.4943041 and batches of 2^20 walks. The batched step keeps the predecessor's field rows and tests; every conditional field correction is a forward branch whose taken fix-up adds its exact extra instructions to a run-wide meter capped after every round at n*CORR+LAMBDA_CAP, CORR=22.473310 per step. Each batch round blinds its prefix chain with a fresh uniform unit rho (charged), so a lane's count depends on its walk point and a uniform prefix only. The cap's abort probability uses only the algorithm's own coins: per-trail Azuma-Hoeffding over independent trail starts with the average premise H-trail, and Hoeffding over independent per-round blinding noise; DELTA_CORR<5.07e-14; the work bound holds regardless. The six product finishes branch on the carry flag (b.cc in place of adc c,xzr,xzr; cbz c), saving 5*(2^20-1)+(2^20-2) = 6,291,449 instructions per 2^20-walk plain round, measured exactly by paired emulated counts against the base kernel; the fixed path is declared at 667,983,493 - 6,291,449 = 661,692,044 instructions per plain round (this kernel's clean emulated round on input set 2: 661,692,016; Callgrind 3.24 in the organizer image and the emulated count both give 42,859,924 for this kernel's round 2 at 2^16 walks and 2^16 adders; a 768-instruction allowance added per round), anchor rounds 5*(2^20-1)+9 more, so C_COMMON=631.618053 and the step charge is 654.096780 against the predecessor's 714.759990. All preprocessing, failures, restarts, table initialization, lookup, transfers, replay, verification and output are included. Peak memory is below 2^77 bytes, preprocessing at most 2^62.848071 units, nonuniform advice zero, and the conditional success margin at least 1e-6 above 0.39. Production probability and universal instruction bounds remain heuristic premises, not certifications. Measurements and finite experiments retain their original scope and attribution.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the revised full production cost ledger (including the correction charge, its meter slack and abort term) and order certificate, then run the inherited complete reduced-order procedure at tau=0.4943, the production value on its 0.0001 grid, retaining failures and replay checks. The two results have distinct scopes; neither establishes production mixing.
